description: Create a public booking page (a hosted scheduling link) for a calendar. Returns a booking_url to send to a human; when they pick a slot, a confirmed event is created on the calendar and an event.created webhook fires with a booking_page_id field. Set availability_constraints to restrict to weekly working hours; existing calendar events always block slots.

active.description: Whether the page accepts bookings (default true).

fri.description: A single day's working hours window

end.description: End of the working window, HH:MM 24-hour, after start (e.g. "17:00")

start.description: Start of the working window, HH:MM 24-hour, in the timezone of the availability rules or booking page it belongs to (e.g. "09:00")

availability_constraints.description: Weekly working hours keyed by day (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun; a day left out takes no bookings), each {"start":"HH:MM","end":"HH:MM"} in 24-hour time with end after start, e.g. {"mon":{"start":"09:00","end":"17:00"}}. Omit/null for any time in the window.

calendar_id.description: Calendar ID a booking resolves to.

description.description: Optional description shown to the booker.

min_notice_minutes.description: Minimum lead time before a bookable slot (default 0).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for display + working hours (default UTC).

title.description: Meeting title shown on the page.

window_days.description: How far ahead bookings are allowed (default 14).
